title: AI-Augmented Fundus Disease Screening by Non-Ophthalmologist Physicians: A Paired Before-After Study.
summary: A paired before-after reader study on 500 fundus photographs shows an AI decision-support tool improving non-ophthalmologists' screening accuracy and referral decisions, with a suitable evaluation design. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
